[RULES]
G1 Extract every entity of the supplied types. Return exact spans from the text.

[TYPE] PERSON
[DESCRIPTION] A person's name.
P1 Label the full name; leave out titles such as "Dr", "Prof", "President" or "Mr".

[TYPE] ORGANIZATION
[DESCRIPTION] A company, university, agency, team or other institution.

[TYPE] LOCATION
[DESCRIPTION] A city, country, region or named place.

[TYPE] EVENT
[DESCRIPTION] A named event, such as a summit, festival, tournament or election.

[TYPE] PRODUCT
[DESCRIPTION] A named product, model, vehicle or piece of software.

[TYPE] NOT_AN_ENTITY
NE1 Job titles and honorifics, such as "Chancellor", "CEO" or "Sir".

[RULES]
G2 An event held in a city is labelled as the event, and the city separately ("Expo 2020 in Dubai"). This overrides everything above.
